name: DOE OIG FY 2025 FERC Cybersecurity Evaluation
known_limitations: FERC is an independent agency within DOE and has a distinct FISMA evaluation boundary. Its effective result cannot be generalized to the Department, laboratories, national security systems, incidents, recovery, or mission effects. Phase 56J keeps the coverage ID, entity identity, attribution, period, evidence state, and continuation rule attached.
source_owner: Department of Energy Office of Inspector General
